components.name: Outline Action
components.description: The primary hard-edged action used against optical surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:3rem; padding:.75rem 1.2rem; border:1px solid var(--paper, #f2f0eb); color:var(--paper, #f2f0eb); font:400 .7rem/1.2 var(--body, Manrope, sans-serif); letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; transition:background .25s, color .25s, transform .25s; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--paper, #f2f0eb); color:var(--ink, #080808); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--paper, #f2f0eb); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: A secondary action that stays visually subordinate to the outlined action.
components.css: .ds-text-link { color:#cbc8c1; font:400 .75rem/1.2 var(--body, Manrope, sans-serif); letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.45rem; } .ds-text-link:hover { color:var(--paper, #f2f0eb); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--paper, #f2f0eb); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Navigation Call to Action
components.description: The final header link, promoted with a quiet hard rule.
components.css: .ds-nav-cta { display:inline-block; border:1px solid rgba(242,240,235,.16); padding:.65rem 1rem; color:var(--paper, #f2f0eb); font:400 .72rem/1.2 var(--body, Manrope, sans-serif); letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { border-color:rgba(242,240,235,.52); } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--paper, #f2f0eb); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Product Plate
components.description: A cropped optical media plane with a directly overlaid label.
components.css: .ds-plate { position:relative; width:15rem; aspect-ratio:9/16; overflow:hidden; margin:0; background:#171719; border:1px solid rgba(242,240,235,.12); opacity:.72; perspective:1000px; transition:opacity .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-plate-media { width:100%; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(117,97,255,.42), #171719 48%, rgba(240,104,53,.3)); filter:saturate(.78) contrast(1.05); transition:filter .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-plate-label { position:absolute; left:.8rem; bottom:.8rem; padding:.4rem .55rem; background:rgba(8,8,8,.78); color:#f2f0eb; font:400 .7rem/1.2 Manrope,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-plate:hover, .ds-plate:focus { opacity:1; border-color:rgba(242,240,235,.58); transform:translateZ(10px); } .ds-plate:hover .ds-plate-media, .ds-plate:focus .ds-plate-media { filter:saturate(1.05) contrast(1.04); transform:scale(1.035); } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2f0eb; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Reel Control
components.description: An in-frame play/pause control for portrait motion reels.
components.css: .ds-reel-control { border:1px solid rgba(242,240,235,.55); background:rgba(8,8,8,.72); color:#f2f0eb; padding:.85rem 1rem; cursor:pointer; font:400 .7rem/1.2 Manrope,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-reel-control:hover { background:#f2f0eb; color:#080808; } .ds-reel-control:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2f0eb; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Comparison Instrument
components.description: A visible measurement line and circular drag handle for before/after evidence.
components.html: BeforeAfter↔
components.css: .ds-compare { position:relative; width:15rem; aspect-ratio:9/16; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#171719 0 50%,#7561ff 50% 100%); color:#f2f0eb; } .ds-before,.ds-after { position:absolute; bottom:.7rem; z-index:2; padding:.35rem .5rem; background:rgba(8,8,8,.78); font:400 .7rem/1.2 Manrope,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; pointer-events:none; } .ds-before { left:.7rem; } .ds-after { right:.7rem; } .ds-line { position:absolute; inset:0 auto 0 50%; width:1px; background:#f2f0eb; } .ds-handle { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; z-index:2; width:2.5rem; height:2.5rem; border-radius:50%; background:#f2f0eb; color:#080808; display:grid; place-items:center; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); font-weight:600; } .ds-compare input { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:3; width:100%; height:100%; opacity:0; cursor:ew-resize; } .ds-compare input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2f0eb; outline-offset:-7px; }

components.name: Verified-Client Lockup
components.description: A compact two-mark proof block with a ruled editorial frame.
components.css: .ds-client-lockup { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); width:min(100%,40rem); margin-left:auto; border-top:1px solid rgba(242,240,235,.16); border-left:1px solid rgba(242,240,235,.16); } .ds-client-mark { min-height:9rem; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:1.5rem; border-right:1px solid rgba(242,240,235,.16); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,240,235,.16); color:#aaa8a3; font:400 .7rem/1.2 Manrope,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:color .3s; } .ds-client-mark:hover { color:#f2f0eb; }

components.name: Luminous Contact Field
components.description: The concluding optical field, framed and illuminated for direct project actions.
components.html:
Got a project in mind?

Send email
components.css: .ds-contact { position:relative; overflow:hidden; padding:5rem 2rem; text-align:center; color:#f2f0eb; background:radial-gradient(45rem 30rem at 15% 110%,rgba(117,97,255,.38),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(42rem 28rem at 90% -10%,rgba(240,104,53,.3),transparent 58%),#101011; border-block:1px solid rgba(242,240,235,.16); } .ds-contact::before { content:""; position:absolute; inset:1rem; border:1px solid rgba(242,240,235,.12); pointer-events:none; } .ds-contact h2 { position:relative; max-width:13ch; margin:0 auto 1.5rem; font:400 clamp(2.7rem,6vw,5.7rem)/1 Unbounded,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.04em; } .ds-contact a { position:relative; display:inline-flex; min-height:3rem; align-items:center; padding:.75rem 1.2rem; border:1px solid #f2f0eb; color:#f2f0eb; font:400 .7rem/1.2 Manrope,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; } .ds-contact a:hover { background:#f2f0eb; color:#080808; } .ds-contact a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2f0eb; outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview:
HERZ FOUNDRY behaves like a controlled optical set rather than a generic dark-agency card stack. Near-black surfaces make the supplied product imagery the brightest evidence; mineral-white type, thin measurement rules, and restrained spectral color create the sense of a precise studio instrument. The first viewport places decisive type directly over full-scale CGI work, while violet and ember act as atmospheric light sources rather than broad brand paint.

The system is cinematic but disciplined. Cropped portrait media, hard-edged controls, asymmetric image plates, and large stretches of darkness build tension without obscuring the work. The experience remains direct: the product is visible immediately, production rigor is demonstrated with real media, and contact actions are unmistakable.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black optical surfaces with mineral-white typography.
Restrained violet and ember light fields used for atmosphere and orientation.
Hard rules, square controls, and cropped media plates instead of soft card stacks.
Asymmetric editorial compositions that resolve into compact grids on small screens.
Motion that clarifies active media and reveal state, with a complete reduced-motion path.

rules.name: The Colored-Light Rule
rules.body: Violet and ember should read as light falling across a dark stage. Keep opaque accent areas rare and use restrained transparency for fields.

rules.name: The Mineral Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use mineral white against optical black for critical text and actions; use muted mineral only for genuinely secondary information.

rules.name: The Engineered Display Rule
rules.body: Unbounded is reserved for decisive names, numbers, and headings. Paragraphs and operational labels remain in Manrope.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Labels gain hierarchy through uppercase and tracking, not bold weight.

rules.name: The Asymmetric Plate Rule
rules.body: Media collections must keep a dominant frame and a supporting rhythm; equal cards are reserved for repeated reels or client marks where comparison is the job.

rules.name: The Optical Depth Rule
rules.body: Create depth with light, crop, tone, and focus. Do not introduce generic floating-card shadows.

rules.name: The Hard-Edge Rule
rules.body: Do not soften primary containers or controls. A circle should signal a draggable instrument, not a general decoration.

dos: Do lead with real product media at full useful scale and retain its portrait crop.
Do use rules, tone, saturation, and colored light to create hierarchy on dark surfaces.
Do keep desktop compositions asymmetric while preserving the dominant/supporting relationship on mobile.
Do keep the mobile stage as one full-bleed dominant image plus three visible, focusable right-rail plates.
Do keep the verified-client proof to the two supplied marks unless additional clients are explicitly verified.
Do preserve the mineral-white focus outline and the keyboard/touch behavior of every interactive media control.
Do treat reduced motion as a complete static presentation, not merely shorter animation.
Do style browser-level details—selection, scrollbar, theme color, and skip navigation—as part of the same optical world.
donts: Don't replace the stage with a generic equal-card grid or add rounded agency-style cards.
Don't hide the three supporting stage frames on mobile or turn them into a swipe-only interaction.
Don't expand the client lockup with unverified or placeholder marks.
Don't flood sections with opaque violet or ember; their restraint is what makes them feel luminous.
Don't add conventional drop shadows, glass panels, glossy pills, or decorative gradients unrelated to stage lighting.
Don't use Unbounded for long paragraphs or increase label hierarchy with heavy weight.
Don't hide focus, rely on hover alone, autoplay video, or leave reveal content suppressed when motion is reduced.
